tasks.analysis: The piano has a rich history that spans over 300 years, evolving from earlier keyboard instruments like the clavichord and harpsichord. The modern piano was invented around 1700 by Bartolomeo Cristofori, who developed a new mechanism that made it possible for players to control the dynamics—soft and loud sounds—by varying the pressure on the keys. Later key improvements include the addition of a cast iron frame and felt-covered hammers, which allowed for greater volume and durability. These changes made the piano a central instrument in both classical and popular music. 钢琴拥有跨越 300 多年的悠久历史，由早期的击弦古钢琴和大键琴等键盘乐器发展而来。现代钢琴约在 1700 年由巴尔托洛梅奥・克里斯托弗里发明，他研发了一种新机械装置，使演奏者能通过按压琴键的力度控制强弱音色。后续重要改进包括增加铸铁框架和毛毡琴槌，提升了音量与耐用性。这些变革让钢琴成为古典音乐与流行音乐中的核心乐器。
